description: Na₃AsSe₃ crystallizes in the cubic P2_13 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six equivalent Se atoms. There are three shorter (2.96 Å) and three longer (3.12 Å) Na-Se bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six equivalent Se atoms. There are three shorter (2.97 Å) and three longer (3.12 Å) Na-Se bond lengths. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six equivalent Se atoms to form distorted corner-sharing NaSe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 59°. There are three shorter (3.09 Å) and three longer (3.26 Å) Na-Se bond lengths. As is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three equivalent Se atoms. All As-Se bond lengths are 2.41 Å. Se is bonded to six Na and one As atom to form a mixture of distorted corner, edge, and face-sharing SeNa₆As pentagonal bipyramids.
